Made this AI slop to entertain myself and figured others might enjoy it too.

- Any content I upload will eventually be full gender/genital transformation, and themes will often include forced MTF / unwillingness / non-consent (goes without saying, but I do not endorse non-consensual sex IRL, this is for kink/fantasy only). - Feel free to do whatever you want with this content (repost, generate your own art, translate, etc), so long as you're not pretending to be me.
